reason: Free listing with flyers loaded for me, sure, I'd let them do it since it costs me nothing. But I'm not paying anything until I see real users in my city, and my crowd is students who live on Instagram already.
objection: I don't have time to manage another platform, and I can't tell if students here will ever open this app instead of just checking Instagram.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the published user number pass 2,000 in my city and a few venues like mine getting real views and ticket sales from it.
